display_name: Phase1非PAMF完整对比：三种子与两GPU依赖队列
description: 四领域方法跨RX与日期／ManyRx；ResNet通用DG、源数量、标签量；六个冻结历史模型补测。162新训练＋6补测，接续既有24行。
authorization: 用户明确继续优化完成设计并完成全部非PAMF对比；保留两GPU、三seed和各方法原生预算，RIEI/DRIFT E100。

code.environment: existing SDG-SEI Py3.8/torch1.11 + existing task-local NumPy1.23.5; legacy uses original CVS-RFFI torch2.1; no shared install

data.version: existing N607 compact datasets and immutable source/received handles
data.physical_ids_ref: each source_contract.json#/role_ids and each validated views/index.npz
data.varying_roles_note: Explicit per-row protocol overrides below; source-count targets remain fixed F0 seven RX.
data.validation_ref: Existing F0 VALIDATED_ONCE reused; new physical-role wrappers validated once by builder
data.leo_config_ref: existing sixscene engine7669a6de, original namespace/seeds, clean plus six practical

permissions.query_use: frozen per-sample inference only; all tasks complete before truth scoring
permissions.claim_scope: exposed terrestrial proxy benchmark; source-RX unseen-date diagnostic separate; no blind/in-orbit claim

checkpoint.initialization: scratch except six historical frozen evaluation rows
sources: none for new training; IB stage2 only same-run stage1
six original standard CE scratch E200 default heads, individually checked before legacy prediction
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: new models scratch; historical rows require strict per-checkpoint provenance and source-role checks at smoke and load
checkpoint.selection_rule: RIEI/DRIFT final E100; IB/SDG minimum source V NLL; ResNet fixed budget; no head refit

execution.gpu_policy: physical0,1 only; one own worker/GPU; CPU prepare/smoke; GPU start only after parent terminal and process gone; wait foreign workloads
execution.stop_rule: output collision, role/contract/nonfinite/no legal prediction or wrong truth closure are technical failures; two matching row failures pause unstarted; healthy rows continue; low scores never stop

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: separate CPU evaluation.score after all-task preflight
